candidate_classes.admissible_if: Official issuer identifies the R7 vocabulary owner and the pre-cutoff bytes directly contain every V8 field for all seven exact R7 targets.
Official pre-cutoff bytes name the delegator, delegate, exact R7 vocabulary scope, powers, effective date and verifiable issuer.

Official pre-cutoff standard bytes identify issuer and drafting/approval process and contain source-native semantic components; this class may pass only the historical-standard-component gate unless it also meets every exact-algebra and authority gate.

Official pre-cutoff standard bytes contain a directly quoted or bounded native semantic component relevant to postpublication status/action, with no R7 mapping inferred; never owner gold or map-audit authority.

capture_rule.fail_closed: Non-2xx, identity mismatch, ambiguous issuer/date, parse failure or indirect copy is CANNOT_CHECK for that field.
capture_rule.forbidden: No search snippet or third-party copy is authority.
capture_rule.method: Exactly one HTTP GET per frozen route using an identifying research User-Agent, redirects followed, 30-second timeout.
capture_rule.raw_retention: No response HTML or PDF retained in the packet; temporary bytes are deleted after hashing and bounded extraction.
capture_rule.record: Requested URL, final URL, capture UTC, status, content type, response byte length, ETag, Last-Modified and SHA-256.

component_gate.full_positive: All gates 1-10 pass for a single lawful completed authority bundle.
component_gate.historical_standard_semantic_component_p: At least one official exact-byte source passes gates 1-3, predates cutoff, and directly exposes a bounded source-native postpublication action/status component. This does not pass gates 4-10 and cannot authorize the map audit.

frozen_routes.expected_identity: NISO RP-45-2024 Communication of Retractions, Removals, and Expressions of Concern
frozen_routes.retention: HTTP provenance, digest, PDF metadata, bounded front-matter authority/date/rights fields, field-presence booleans; delete response bytes after evaluation.

frozen_routes.expected_identity: Official NISO publication landing page for RP-45-2024
frozen_routes.retention: HTTP provenance, digest, bounded issuer/date/rights fields and field-presence booleans; delete response bytes after evaluation.

non_substitution_rules: Standards authorship, standards committee participation and issuer identity do not imply R7 vocabulary ownership or delegation.
Repository authorship and unsigned Git commits do not imply vocabulary ownership, host authority, rights, independent review or adapter blindness.
Structural analogues and source-native terms do not map to an R7 decision and do not create owner gold.
Partial standard semantics cannot authorize or rerun the unchanged 117,649-map audit.

ordered_gates.pass_rule: Official route resolves with 2xx status, expected identity/issuer is present, exact response length and SHA-256 are bound.
Official bytes expose an unambiguous publication/issuance date strictly before 2026-08-20T11:55:11Z.
Official bytes explicitly identify the issuing institution; an R7 owner passes only if the exact R7 vocabulary owner is explicitly identified.
Delegator, delegate, exact R7 scope, conferred powers, effective date and official evidence are explicit.
Applicable rights holder binds a licence permitting the planned storage, processing, derived adjudication, audit quotation and artifact release tier.

Source directly governs KEEP_SEARCH, KEEP_COMPILE, KEEP_REPAIR, REVISE_MEASUREMENT, REFORMULATE_OBJECTIVE, REFORMULATE_BOUNDARY and UNRESOLVED as the exact R7 targets; no semantic mapping or analogy is used.
All required V8 algebra fields are present for all seven exact targets, including closed world, coordinates, operations, bridge, terminal behavior, authority, rights and ratification.
The exact host authority signs recommendation, execution, adoption, promotion and merge boundaries.
A complete owner algebra predates the cutoff, or prospective adapter-blind allowlisted delivery and signed custody receipts exist.
A content-addressed CONFORMANT review is signed by an eligible reviewer with no algebra authorship, case/outcome custody or adapter exposure.

prohibitions: No case text or outcome access.
No AI agent, local verifier or same-repository process labelled external custody or independent review.
No fabricated signature, delegation, rights grant, review, custody, gold or certified map.
No manuscript or claim-ledger edit unless the full prospective scientific gate passes.
No rerun of the 117,649-map audit unless all authority and ordering gates pass.
scientific_question: Before the frozen R7 target-program cutoff, does an official immutable source directly evidence a complete owner-authored seven-target algebra or explicit formal delegation sufficient to bind any V10 authority act without inference from repository authorship, structural analogy, or later approval?
